title: Anthropic expands Google Cloud use to up to one million TPUs, worth tens of billions

sources.quote: The expansion is worth tens of billions of dollars and is expected to bring well over a gigawatt of capacity online in 2026.

Anthropic will have access to up to one million TPU chips, as well as additional Google Cloud services, which will empower its research and development teams with leading AI-optimized infrastructure for years to come.

explain: Anthropic agreed to rent up to one million of Google's TPU AI chips, more than a gigawatt of computing in 2026. The companies said it is worth 'tens of billions of dollars' but gave no exact number, so the amount is left blank.
